subject: Renewal restructure — annualized billing + Q4 burst capacity add-on
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@horizonretail.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Horizon Retail Procurement <procurement@horizonretail.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 15:08:00 +0000
Subject: Renewal restructure — annualize billing + Q4 burst capacity add-on

Hi Soojin,

Our renewal for Redwood (current term expires 2027-01-15) is coming up and the exec team wants to simplify the contract structure and make space for a short-term capacity spike over Black Friday/Cyber Week. Two asks: 1) can we annualize the payments instead of the current quarterly true-up to smooth our finance cadence; and 2) can we add a Q4 "burst" pool (approx +50k tokens/day peak) that we can draw from for promotions, with clear overage handling?

We prefer minimal operational friction — procurement needs a pricing sheet and an SOW we can review by next week (target: sign by 2026-12-22 to get systems in place). Let me know what options you can offer (annualized vs multi-year, price protection, any discounts for committing to a muted ramp).

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of AI Platform
Horizon Retail

---

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@horizonretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 17:02:14 +0000
Subject: RE: Renewal restructure — annualize billing + Q4 burst capacity add-on

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear asks. I pulled together two pragmatic options and attached a short SOW with implementation steps (renewal_options_v2.pdf, SOW-burst-capacity.xlsx). High level: 

Option A — Annualize (12-months) + burst as pre-purchased credits
- Annual billing (single invoice) timed to your fiscal quarter (we can co-term to 2027-01-15)
- Pre-purchase burst credits (one-time add) redeemable across Q4 (credits expire 2027-02-28)
- No change to base committed capacity; burst only used when needed
- Pricing example: list price + 3% fee for on-demand access; prepaid rate shown in attached doc

Option B — 24-month price protection + annual billing (recommended if you want stability)
- 24-month price protection with annual invoicing (you still pay annually but get guaranteed price for 24 months)
- Includes a smaller prepaid burst pool + ability to purchase additional credits on short notice
- 5% discount on base commit if you elect 24-month protection (see sheet)

Next steps I propose: confirm preferred option, we issue a redline-ready SOW + DocuSign, and Marissa will own the rollout schedule for the burst pool. If procurement needs us to align to a specific PO/invoice cadence we can accept that in SOW.

Karthik / Marissa — tagging you both for pricing/ops signoff. Samir, attaching the two files now.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: renewal_options_v2.pdf (pricing + comparison), SOW-burst-capacity.xlsx (implementation and invoicing details)

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 18:15:09 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal restructure — annualize billing + Q4 burst capacity add-on

Soojin — looks good. A couple of suggested tweaks before we send to procurement: 

- Make the burst pool prepaid credits that can be drawn across months; it avoids complex monthly reconciliations and keeps cost predictable for Horizon.
- Recommend co-terming to 2027-01-15 (keeps renewal cadence consistent).
- Offer a one-time onboarding credit (equivalent to 2 weeks of burst usage) if they sign by 2026-12-22. It helps reduce friction for the smoke test.
- Discounting: 5% for 12-month annualize, 10% for a firm 24-month commit. Keep SLA and exception language unchanged.

Also confirm internal ops: do we need an SLA exception to support the burst pool on a dedicated capacity slice? Marissa, can you confirm the timeline for provisioning a temporary capacity pool and monitoring?

Karthik Iyer
VP Sales | Redwood Inference

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@horizonretail.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 09:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal restructure — annualize billing + Q4 burst capacity add-on

Hi Samir — happy to coordinate the rollout. Operational notes: 

- Provisioning: we can create a dedicated burst pool on our Dedicated cluster and tag it to your account. Expect ~72 hours for capacity allocation once the SOW is signed and the PO is received.
- Ramp plan: 2-week smoke test (1 week low-volume validation, 1 week peak simulation) prior to live Black Friday traffic. We will provide a test token quota for validations.
- Monitoring: we'll enable per-route token telemetry and alerts to your on-call alias. We'll also set a consumption threshold to auto-notify both teams at 70%/90%/100% of prepaid credits.
- Invoicing: we will bill the prepaid burst as a separate line item on the annual invoice for clarity.

If you confirm Option B (24-month protection + annual billing) I will add the provisioning timeline to the SOW and trigger capacity reservations on signature.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

---

From: Samir Patel <samir@horizonretail.com>

Team — thanks for the quick turnaround. We want to move forward with Option B (24-month price protection + annual invoicing) and the prepaid burst credits model. The onboarding credit you proposed is appreciated and will help with internal approvals.

Procurement: please coordinate with Soojin for PO details. Soojin/Marissa — please send the updated SOW and DocuSign link and copy procurement@horizonretail.com on the envelope. Target: sign by 2026-12-22 so we can start provisioning.
